label: original-phase input of o/a/k/p (context-gated)
explanation: Almost entirely an original-phase unit (99.8% of mass; never at t=0 or the delimiter, and almost never in the copy phase). It fires mainly when the input token is o, a, k or p (78% of mass), less often on u/f/n/v/d, and much more on the first occurrence of a token. Whether it fires on these tokens depends on earlier context: it is stronger when the previous input is i/n/a/v/u, and when the sequence starts with y or contains y/l/i earlier. The largest activations are o/a/p after prefixes like y y ... i. It fires on only about 13% of o/a/k/p original-phase steps, so precision is low; prefix and previous-token conditions raise precision to 0.2-0.37 but cost recall, and no simple predicate went above F1 0.37 on dev.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: t=1 & prev_tok=a (+8.17), t=1 & prev_tok=i (+7.66), t=1 & prev_tok=n (+5.92), t=1 & prev_tok=u (+4.50), orig0=y (+3.97), in_tok=o (+3.61). Lower it: orig_idx=-1 (-6.79), in_tok=y (-4.17), in_tok=l (-3.93), in_tok=0 (-3.92).
